content.title: New Mexico vs Tulsa Prediction: NIT Semifinal Preview, Odds, Key Players and Match Analysis – April 2, 2026
content.text: The NIT tournament is down to its final four teams, and one of the semifinal matchups features the New Mexico Lobos facing the Tulsa Golden Hurricane. Both teams have enjoyed strong seasons and now meet with a place in the NIT championship game on the line. New Mexico enters the game with solid form after several convincing wins during the tournament run. Tulsa has also shown impressive performances and arrives with confidence after defeating multiple opponents on its way to the semifinal stage.GamesDiscover moreDemographicssportsCity & Local Guides The game is expected to be closely contested, with both teams bringing strong offensive production and capable defenses into the matchup. Tactical Matchup Tulsa relies heavily on outside shooting, ranking among the better teams in effective field goal percentage.
